ui.cli.help.title: Everything Mapped for Clients: a guided intake that maps everything a web or app project needs to know.
ui.cli.help.cmd.install: Install the interview for Claude Code and Codex
ui.cli.help.cmd.check: Show what is answered and what is still missing
ui.cli.help.cmd.next: Show the next questions to ask, as JSON
ui.cli.help.cmd.answer: Save answers from a JSON file into the pack
ui.cli.help.cmd.assets: List the files you provide and write them down
ui.cli.help.cmd.pack: Collect the pack in one zip file to send
ui.cli.help.options: Options (not every command uses every option):
ui.cli.help.opt.global: Install for your whole user account (global); --user does the same
ui.cli.help.opt.local: Install in the project folder (local, the default); can be combined with -g
ui.cli.help.opt.dir: The project folder for a local install (default: the current folder)
ui.cli.help.opt.dryRun: Show what would happen and change nothing
ui.cli.help.opt.force: Replace an interview that is already installed
ui.cli.help.opt.lang: Language of the messages: da or en
ui.cli.help.opt.root: The folder with your answers (default: the current folder)
ui.cli.help.opt.out: The folder to save the zip file in (default: the current folder)
ui.cli.help.opt.json: Print the result as JSON (for check and pack)
ui.cli.help.example.install: Install in the current project folder
ui.cli.help.example.installGlobal: Install for your whole user account
ui.cli.help.example.installBoth: Install in the project folder and for your user account
ui.cli.help.example.pack: Make the zip file to send
ui.cli.help.footer: Everything stays on your computer. This tool never connects to the internet.
ui.cli.error.missingValue: The option {option} needs a value after it.
ui.cli.error.unexpectedValue: The option {option} does not take a value.
ui.cli.error.badLang: The language must be da or en, not {value}.
ui.cli.error.tryHelp: Run "everything-mapped help" to see what you can do.
ui.install.prompt.title: Which tool should the interview be installed for?
ui.install.prompt.question: Type 1, 2 or 3 and press Enter (Enter alone means both):
ui.install.scope.user: Installing for your user account (home folder {dir})
ui.install.dryRun.header: Dry run: nothing will be written.
ui.install.dryRun.replace: The existing copy at {path} would be removed first.
ui.install.dryRun.done: Dry run finished. Nothing was written.
ui.install.warn.staleBackup: A backup of an old copy is still here: {path}. It holds files of the old copy and is not used. If you need anything from it, take it out, then delete the folder yourself.
ui.install.warn.staleStaging: A half-finished install from an earlier run is still here: {path}. Nothing in it is used. Delete the folder yourself.
ui.install.warn.backupLeft: The new copy is installed, but the backup of the old copy could not be removed: {path}. Delete that folder yourself when you are sure you do not need it.
ui.install.summary.title: Summary
ui.install.summary.user: Global, for your user account (home folder {dir}): {tools}
ui.install.next.title: Next step
ui.install.next.project: Open a terminal in {dir}, then start the interview:
ui.install.next.user: Open a terminal in the folder of your project, then start the interview:
ui.install.next.claude: Claude Code: run claude, then type /everything-mapped
ui.install.remove.dryRunDone: Dry run finished. Nothing was removed.
ui.install.remove.scope.user: Removing from your user account (home folder {dir})
ui.install.remove.kept: Left in place, because this tool did not install it: {path}
ui.install.remove.changed: Kept, because you changed it after it was installed: {path}
ui.install.remove.keptFolder: The folder {path} was kept because it still holds your own files. Run uninstall again when they are gone to remove the rest.
ui.install.error.noTool: Neither Claude Code nor Codex was found on this computer. Install one of them first, or add --claude or --codex to put the files in place anyway.
ui.install.error.noChoice: No valid choice was made. Nothing was installed.
ui.install.error.dirNeedsLocal: --dir is only for a local install. Add --local, or leave out --dir.
ui.install.error.sameFolder: The local and the global install would go to the same folder ({dir}). Use only one of them.
ui.install.error.homeNotAbsolute: Your home folder is given as a relative path ({dir}). Set HOME (USERPROFILE on Windows) to a full path and try again.
ui.install.error.badDir: The folder name contains a character that is not allowed.
ui.install.error.dirMissing: The folder {dir} does not exist. Create it first or check the spelling.
ui.install.error.sourceMissing: The interview files are missing from this copy of the tool (looked in {path}). Download the tool again and try again.
ui.install.error.sourceLink: The interview folder contains a link ({path}). Links are never copied. Nothing was installed.
ui.install.error.sourceOdd: {path} is not an ordinary file or folder. Nothing was installed.
ui.install.error.hashMismatch: The copy of {path} does not match the original. The install was stopped.
ui.install.error.leftBehind: The unfinished folder {path} could not be removed. Please remove it yourself.
ui.install.error.exists: The interview is already installed at {path}. Nothing was changed. Add --force to replace it.
ui.install.error.existsNoRecord: {path} already exists, but it has no install record, so it is not a complete copy made by this tool. Nothing was changed. If it is a broken or unfinished copy, delete the folder yourself and run the install again.
ui.install.error.unsafeRemove: Refusing to remove {path}: it is not an installed copy of this interview.
ui.install.error.isLink: {path} is a link. Nothing was changed. Remove the link yourself and try again.
ui.install.error.parentLink: {path} is a link, so files written or removed there could end up somewhere else than expected. Nothing was changed. Replace the link with a real folder, or remove it, and try again.
ui.install.error.parentNotFolder: {path} exists but is not a folder. Nothing was changed.
ui.install.error.parentOutside: {path} leads outside the chosen folder. Nothing was changed.
ui.install.error.noRecord: {path} has no install record ({record}), so this tool leaves it alone. Nothing was changed or removed. If it is a broken or unfinished copy of the interview, delete the folder yourself, then run the install again.
ui.install.error.badRecord: The install record {record} in {path} cannot be read or is not valid, so this tool leaves the folder alone. Nothing was changed or removed. If it is a broken copy, delete the folder yourself, then run the install again.
ui.install.error.leftoverCollides: {path} is your own file, but this tool needs to install a file with the same name. Nothing was changed. Move or rename your file, then try again.
ui.install.error.inTheWay: {path} is in the way: this tool needs to put a file or folder there, but a link, a folder or another kind of item is there instead of a plain file it installed. Nothing was changed. Move or rename it, then try again.
ui.install.error.restoreFailed: The install failed, and the old files could not all be put back. They are saved in {path}. Copy them back by hand.
ui.install.error.changedCollides: {path} was changed after it was installed, and this tool would have to replace it. Nothing was changed. Move or rename your version, then try again.
ui.install.error.notRealFolder: {path} is a link or not a folder, so files cannot be written there safely. Nothing was changed. Remove it yourself and try again.
ui.install.error.notFolder: {path} is not a folder. Nothing was changed. Remove it yourself and try again.
ui.pack.counts: Questions: {complete} complete, {partial} partly answered, {tbd} for later, {missing} not answered.
ui.pack.core.ready: Everything needed to start the project is answered.
ui.pack.core.notReady: Must-have questions not fully answered yet: {count}. You can still send the pack.
ui.pack.refreshed: The list of open questions and the pack summary are up to date.
ui.pack.swept: Removed unfinished temporary files that an earlier run left in the output folder: {names}
ui.pack.files.title: Files in the zip file:
ui.pack.warn.large: The pack is {size}. Many e-mail services refuse files this large. Use a file transfer service instead.
ui.pack.skipped: Not put in the zip file: {path}
ui.pack.send.title: What to send
ui.pack.send.only: It already contains everything. Do not send anything else.
ui.pack.send.shaHint: Give this code to the person who receives the file. They can use it to check that the file arrived unchanged.
ui.pack.error.noAnswers: The pack has no answers yet, so there is nothing to send. Answer some questions first, then run this again.
ui.pack.error.notPlain: {path} is a link or a special file and cannot be put in the zip file. Replace it with a normal file and try again.
ui.pack.error.outInsideDocs: Save the zip file outside the docs folder, not in {dir}.
ui.pack.error.names: Some files cannot be put in the zip file. Rename or remove them and try again:
ui.pack.reason.notPlain: it is not an ordinary file (a link, a pipe or something else that cannot be put in a zip file)
ui.pack.reason.tooLarge: the file is {size}, which is above the limit of {max}
ui.pack.error.linkedFolder: {path} is a link, not a real folder. Nothing was written. Replace it with a real folder and try again.
ui.pack.error.packTooLarge: The files in the pack add up to {size}. The limit is {max}. Remove large files from docs/assets and try again.
ui.pack.error.tooManyFiles: The pack has {count} files. The limit is {max}. Remove some files from docs/assets and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.tooManyEntries: The pack has {count} files. A zip file made by this tool can hold at most {max}.
ui.pack.error.zip.tooLarge: The pack is too large for this tool (the limit is 4 GiB). Remove large files from docs/assets and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.badName: The file name {name} cannot be put in a zip file, because it would not work on every computer (for example on Windows). Rename the file and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.unreadableFile: The file {name} is a link, is not an ordinary file, or cannot be read. No zip file was made. Replace it with an ordinary file and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.nameTooLong: The file name {name} is too long for the pack: no part of the path may be longer than {partBytes} bytes, and the whole path may not be longer than {characters} characters. Shorten or rename the file and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.fileChanged: The file {name} changed while the zip file was being made. Close the programs that use it and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.duplicateName: The names {other} and {name} are the same, or differ only in upper and lower case, so they would overwrite each other on Windows and macOS. Rename one of the files and try again.
ui.pack.error.zip.needsNewerNode: This tool needs Node.js 22.2 or newer.
ui.pack.error.writeFailed: Could not write the zip file: {message}
